purpose: Teach: 独創/船舶/専務/チェックイン/資する/格別/見返り/退任

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 独創性、若い頃から磨いてきた。
lines.en: Originality — I've been cultivating it since I was young.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful opening. Slight pause before the dash. Voice settles into memory. Not teaching — simply sharing what time has shown. Steady eye.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。船舶事業、専務に任せ、軌道に乗せます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm entrusting the shipping division to the Senior Vice President to get it back on track.
lines.style: Respectful, measured delivery. Direct but not clipped. Slight weight on the commitment. Clear acknowledgment — not rushing past the gravity of the responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 国際的チェックイン、グローバル人材を活用しろ。
lines.en: International operations need real oversight — bring in your global team.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Quiet confidence in the direction. Light emphasis on 「グローバル人材」 — the specificity matters. Straightforward, no padding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社会に資する取り組み、CSRで強化しています。
lines.en: We're strengthening those efforts — making sure our social responsibility work is genuine, not just on paper.
lines.style: Deliberate, careful. Slight warmth underneath the formality. Not defensive, but earnest about the distinction being made. Steady pacing. Conviction without performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 格別な顧客、見返りに頼るな。
lines.en: Valued clients — don't let yourself depend on what they owe you in return.
lines.style: Sharp, gentle warning. Light but firm. A grandfather's wisdom wrapped in few words. Pause before the second part — letting it land. Not accusatory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。私の退任後も、信頼の絆、続きますように。
lines.en: Yes. I hope that trust continues — even after I step down.
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable close. Soft on 「信頼」. Voice trails slightly at the end, not sad but tender. The weight of legacy without needing to say it outright.
